answer: Ferrous rotate-and-shatter slots. Each epoch, a public randomness beacon assigns every agent a slot in a rotation order; the tide of slots shifts unpredictably, so an attacker cannot know in advance which identity will face a challenge. A random subset of slots must answer a live challenge within a short window or lose their slot. Fresh sybil identities must pre-commit hardware and bandwidth to every possible slot assignment; since the rotation is only revealed after commitments lock, the falcon attacker must equip all identities for all positions,
